messages:
morgan: heads-up — starting an RFC follow-up on api ingress contracts + per-route fallback behavior. want to align on where we validate tokens/claims and what the proxy must forward downstream.
eli: when you say ingress you mean the public edge proxy (nginx/traffic) or the internal api-gateway as well?
priya: both matter, but different obligations. edge should do signature/format checks, gateway can enforce route permissions. :thinking:
taylor: agree. we also need consistent telemetry so we can split ingress rejects vs service rejects in dashboards.
ops: migration question — we have old org-scoped keys and new project-scoped keys. how should fallback work if a route expects project scope?
morgan: proposal: ingress validates minimal correctness (sig, expiry) and surfaces claims as headers, e.g. `X-Actor-ID`, `X-Authz-Claims`. final allow/deny stays with the service unless ingress policy explicitly denies.
eli: prefer stronger fail-fast at ingress for malformed or obviously insufficient scopes. avoids expensive downstream calls. but we need a compatibility toggle.
priya: also: fallback policy must not escalate. if route mapping is missing, fallback -> org-default-deny, not org-default-allow. we can permit a read-only org fallback for safe routes.
priya: example config sketch:
```
ingress:
  validate_minimal: true        # sig, ttl, format
  propagate:
    - X-Actor-ID
    - X-Authz-Claims
  fallback_policy: org-default-deny
  compatibility_window_days: 14
```
ops: having `compatibility_window_days` is great. ops can flip strict mode per region. how do we handle rate-limit mapping when token type changes?
taylor: map rate limits by actor-id + token-type header propagated by ingress. keep a mapping table in the rate limiter service. log both old+new token prefixes during migration.
sec-bot: FYI — key rotation job will add new prefix `rwd-v2:` next week. ingress matcher should accept `rwd-` and `rwd-v2-` during the window.
morgan: good catch. make sure the ingress matcher has a small allowlist for legacy prefixes and emits `x-legacy-key` flag when used.
eli: +1 for explicit reason codes on rejects: `ingress_reject`, `service_reject`, `fallback_mapped`. makes dashboards actionable.
priya: for services that want to be stricter, we should provide an `enforce-ingress` annotation they can opt into; this means service trusts ingress headers and skips revalidation. default is `false`.
ops: rollout plan idea: 1) deploy ingest header propagation in canary, 2) enable telemetry, 3) run compatibility window with logs only, 4) enable strict deny in staged regions, 5) full rollout.
morgan: i'll draft the short RFC + rollout checklist with the config snippet and telemetry metrics (counts by reason code, legacy-prefix hits, fallback uses). will share tomorrow. please ping if there are blockers. :thumbsup:
sec-bot: note recorded: ticket #SEC-2026 created for ingress matcher update and telemetry dashboards.
priya: acked. i'll add tests for `X-Authz-Claims` parsing and fallback behaviour.
taylor: i'll wire the dashboard panels and alert thresholds for rising `fallback_mapped` rates.
ops: will coordinate the canary regions.
morgan: thanks all — moving to doc stage.
